title: A worker records a decision; the master finds out
trigger: a worker decides something while the master is busy elsewhere, and nobody sends a message

steps.text: Calls node_create (kind decision) with its actor name.
The worker's own MCP server validates the write and opens a transaction.
BEGIN IMMEDIATE takes the write lock: any other session's write waits (busy_timeout), so writes are serial.
The node row is inserted, created_by = the worker.
The same transaction writes an attributed change row.
Later, the master calls changes_since with the `now` from its last call.
The master's own server reads change rows after that time: the worker's write is visible because both connect to the same file.
It opens the new node with node_get and acts on it.
